The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy launched a federal eVTOL pilot program in Texas, which will use Joby demo flights to help shape future air-taxi operations and accelerate electric air mobility planning [FAA and Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy marked the launch](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxNQmxQcFBSX0VUcHlYb0M5RFQ4X2FfYW84djUyazFmb3dpWHdXV09lRXlZdmIxb1NpRVlLNlpJNnp1RW8zQVBydTllWUhaVnh6TnJEN3VlLTZBc2pleTRWUzlWdXp1bnNVTlBHTHhPRTFHUERvZWFLR1lXM0EwX21wbXA2RVBGVHdHWmJsOGR5ek1ZX3U5RmxB?oc=5). In other U.S. transportation developments, the Federal Transit Administration (FTA) delivered $233 million to modernize rail transit infrastructure [FTA delivered $233 million](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxOTHllUnMyTVQ3bm1tM1hfT21fdU9wclZJTlRrbFd4UE5wMFpuYVJxdmNyVzFtTkJBT0pWRlBxRUc5QVRoR1VMd0lJY2M5WVlGWlc5U1FPS1A5QVVEeG5hMElFX3VJOE01b0xhMkliQWthQUdJd1Jsd0QzS21Pd0xBam1YV1pEM0wycXByWUI0NGxHMjFUUVk3TkF4YTlWV0RxMVpz?oc=5).

International autonomous vehicle and drone activity shows a trend toward expanded operational permits and procurement. Spain granted its first Level 4 autonomous-vehicle permit to Uber, WeRide, and Avomo for robotaxi testing in Madrid [Spain granted its first Level 4 autonomous-vehicle permit](https://news.google.?oc=5). Additionally, Volatus Aerospace said it won a 5-year contract to supply drones to the Canadian Army [Volatus Aerospace said it won a five-year contract](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/volatus-aerospace-awarded-five-contract-170217982.html), while AeroVironment said it received its first international order for the LOCUST directed-energy counter-drone system, a deal reported at more than $50 million in one version [AeroVironment said it received its first international order](https://www.uasvision.com/2026/09/11/av-gets-first-international-order-for-locust-directed-energy-counter-drone-systems/).

Defense risks and industrial shifts also emerged this period. Iran said it captured a malfunctioning U.S. Dive-LD underwater drone, raising concerns about reverse engineering [Iran said it captured a malfunctioning U.S. Dive-LD underwater drone](https://www.military.com/iran-seizes-us-underwater-drone-raising-reverse-engineering-risk). Regarding domestic production, PDW CEO James Slider said American drone manufacturing must scale domestic production of critical parts, including batteries, electronics, and motors [PDW CEO James Slider says American drone manufacturing must scale domestic production](https://dronelife.com/2026/09/10/american-drone-manufacturing-us-made-parts/).
